title: High Noon.
old_caption: Great date, then a nine-hour standoff over who texts first. Waiting to seem cool just wastes the good feeling. If you had fun, say so. You might be texting at the same second.

title: Potion Class.
old_caption:
Gemini ignores the label and pours the whole love potion. Taurus falls for a chair instead.
You can't make someone feel something for you. Be yourself, ask honestly, and let them choose.

title: The Star Who Won't Give Up.
old_caption:
Planets in a row, a full moon, a stranger with a dog, "hi" spelled in the stars. And you're looking at your phone.
Sometimes the best thing you can do is look up. Life may be trying to find you.

title: Dear Aries: Houston traffic.
old_caption:
Aries, stuck in traffic, already panicking about being late?
Send the "running late" text. Patience is a love language too.

title: Dear Atlanta.
old_caption:
Cancer, still peeking from behind the trees?
The right one is out there looking for you too. Step into the light.

title: The Auntie Council reviews Houston.
old_caption:
What would your aunties say about your love life?
The Auntie Council says love is mostly showing up, and Houston passed.

title: The Auntie Council reviews Texas.
old_caption:
What would your aunties grade your city's dating scene?
Texas got an A+ for patience, listening and showing up. Love travels.

title: Dear Austin.
old_caption:
Do you listen to your date the way you listen to live music?
Give them that same full attention. Listen like it's live.

title: Buffalo Bayou at night.
old_caption:
Is your idea of a perfect date just a quiet walk?
Virgo and Pisces agree: slow walks beat loud bars.

title: Texas BBQ takes hours.
old_caption:
Ever wanted a new connection to be ready right now?
Brisket can't be rushed. Neither can trust. Low and slow.
